plugins.name: cli-dispatch
plugins.description: Delegate tasks to a DeepSeek worker CLI from inside Claude Code. DeepSeek-only fork of rbinar/cli-dispatch: only the DeepSeek backend (claude-ds, ds-agent) remains — Antigravity/Gemini, Codex/OpenAI, OpenCode/OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot were removed. Deterministic runner (cli-dispatch-run — worker + verify with zero LLM babysitter tokens), single-command ds-agent, session tracking (live monitoring + resume), runtime/idle timeout safety net, and fully-agentic tasks in isolated git worktrees.
